**Finding: Missing — vendor insurance (severity: low)**

The agreement has no insurance clause at all. The only mention of "insurance" (p0051) simply allocates taxes, duties, insurance and shipping costs to our client — it imposes nothing on Licensor. Licensor supplies and supports the Licensed Technology through which we receive consolidated market data and transmit Spot FX orders, and it receives our output data for error reproduction (p0092) plus our Confidential Information, so it squarely fits the profile of a technology vendor that should carry standard coverages.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new General Provisions subsection (l), inserted after p0159 and before the execution block — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M where Licensor touches our data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates of insurance on request, maintained through the term plus one year.

The covenant binds Licensor only, so it adds no obligation to our client. Fallback if pushed: E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.
